name: cloakroom
description: Local privacy gate for AI coding agents: secrets and PII are masked before the model sees them, restored only for local tools.

plugins.name: cloakroom
plugins.description: Masks secrets and personal data in prompts, file reads and command output before Claude sees them; restores the real values only for local tools (Write, Edit, Bash). Installs the cloakroom command itself on first start (with uv, pipx or Python 3.10+): rules-only protection at once, the model a few minutes later.
